title: God Bless You, Go With God
firstLine: This is my daily prayer, God bless you, go with God,

lines: This is my daily prayer, God bless you, go with God,
Hold fast His mighty hand, through the day;
His grace your heart sustain, His power relieve your pain,
Your prayer be not in vain, as you travel His way.
In spite of all the lies, that some may hurl,
rist is the only hope of all the world;
God bless you, go with God,
Thru all eternity, My prayer will always be,
